title: Price Adjustments
description: Ordered selection-dependent fee and discount rows on a binding fixed-price option. fixed_price is the base rate, charged when the buyer selects no declared value. A row matches when the buyer's selection includes its value (full-identity match). At most one row fires per dimension — the first match in declared order; firing rows apply in declared order to a running total starting at fixed_price (rate rows apply to the running total, so 10% then 10% is x1.21), rounded half away from zero to the option's price precision after each row, never below zero. Omitted or default selections match no row. The resolved total is the purchase's fixed_price. Changing the table requires a new pricing_option_id. Sellers MUST NOT return a table to callers below adcp_version 3.3; consumers treat an unknown dimension as unpurchasable. Normative rules: docs/media-buy/advanced-topics/pricing-models.mdx#selection-dependent-price-adjustments.

format_option_ref.description: Matches when the purchase's format_option_refs includes this reference; MUST resolve to a format option of the same product.

placement_ref.description: Matches when a mode selected placement_selection includes this placement; MUST resolve to a targetable placement of the same product, which MUST declare overlay_support.placement_selection.

kind.description: fee raises the running total; discount lowers it.

name.description: Name carried into the resolved price_breakdown.

rate.description: Decimal proportion of the running total at this row's position (0.15 for 15%). Mutually exclusive with amount.

amount.description: Fixed amount in the option's currency per pricing unit. Mutually exclusive with rate.

verifier_constraints.selector_resolution: Each row's ref MUST resolve to a value the same product publishes; matching is full-identity equality after resolution.
verifier_constraints.resolution: One row per dimension (first match); firing rows apply in declared order to a running total from fixed_price; round half away from zero to option price precision per row; never negative (reject with INVALID_REQUEST, never clamp).
verifier_constraints.resolved_price_binding: A buyer-supplied pricing that differs from the resolved result MUST be rejected with INVALID_REQUEST; the seller MUST NOT silently reprice.
verifier_constraints.snapshot_rederivation: In accepted purchase pricing, re-resolving the retained table from base_fixed_price over the purchase's selections equals fixed_price.
